verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs reference an 'Issue Status' page (states-triage) that implies distinct regression tracking, and separate Alerts documentation, but the evidence pack provides only page titles with no substantive text confirming a specific 'regression' alert type distinct from new-issue alerts. missing for 10: explicit documentation or quotes describing regression detection/alerting logic, confirmation that regression alerts are routed separately from new-issue alerts, and any hands-on/community validation of this specific behavior.
